title: stack.json
description: Describes one catalog entry: the stack directory that holds this stack.json. Paths are relative to that directory.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file format. Only 1 exists.

name.description: Name of the entry. It becomes the API object name, so it follows the Kubernetes name rules and must not change once released.

description.description: Text shown on the card and the detail view.

author.description: One name: a person, a team or a company.

maintainers.description: Names or GitHub handles of the people who maintain the entry.

icon.description: An SVG or PNG file in the stack directory. A URL is not allowed. Without an icon the UI shows the default one.

readme.description: A Markdown file in the stack directory.

platformVersion.description: Platform versions that can run the entry: one or more comparisons, each an operator and a full X.Y.Z version, separated by a space or a comma. Example: ">=5.1.0 <6.0.0". The syntax is kept narrow so that every value is also a valid range for the Platform.

members.description: Paths or globs of the manifest files the entry installs. Only files listed here are installed.

version.description: Reserved for a later version mechanism. Accepted with any value and ignored, so that a Platform that is already shipped does not reject it.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the stack directory, with / as separator. It must not start with /, contain a .. segment, a backslash, a colon or a control character. The colon rule also rejects URLs.
